description: This file is a shell script for performing failsafe data check and upgrade procedures on embedded devices using U-Boot. It handles image size, offset, and checksum calculations, updates environment variables, and writes firmware components to flash memory.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_failsafe_datachk
methods.description: Performs data check and upgrade process for failsafe mode, including calculating sizes, checksums, updating environment variables, and flashing firmware components.
